name: openmucf-rate-ledger
title: OpenMuCF FAIR rate ledger (curated compilation with provenance)
description: A curated compilation with provenance of the microscopic rates, validation targets, uncertainty-quantification priors, and muon-production energy costs used by OpenMuCF. This is a provenance-tagged compilation of published values, NOT an independently evaluated nuclear-data library.

fields.name: symbol
fields.description: Unique machine key for the rate/parameter.

fields.name: description
fields.description: One human-readable line.

fields.name: value
fields.description: The numeric value in the stated unit.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Physical unit, e.g. s^-1, percent, fraction, MeV.

fields.name: unc
fields.description: 1-sigma-style uncertainty in the same unit; 0 where the source quotes none, '-' where the row's spread is carried by distribution/dist_lo/dist_hi instead.

fields.name: unc_type
fields.description: Provenance of the uncertainty: stat, exp, theory, theory-spread, model, table, estimate, exact.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Physical state the value holds at (T, phi, F, ortho/para, c_t, field).

fields.name: source_bibkey
fields.description: Key(s) resolvable in references.bib; ';'-separable.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Equation/table/figure/page within the source; '-' where the source states none.

fields.name: status
fields.description: established or contested.

fields.name: validity_range
fields.description: Regime the row is valid over.

fields.name: single_source
fields.description: True if it traces to a single, never-independently-rechecked measurement.

fields.name: needs_verification
fields.description: True if the exact digit/locator is not yet pinned from the primary text.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Context, competing values, VERIFY TODOs.

fields.name: distribution
fields.description: Sampling distribution shape for UQ, if applicable.

fields.name: dist_lo
fields.description: Lower bound for the UQ distribution, if applicable.

fields.name: dist_hi
fields.description: Upper bound for the UQ distribution, if applicable.

fields.name: recommendation
fields.description: Recommended-use note for the row.

fields.name: phase
fields.description: Typed projection of conditions: physical phase ('any' = condition-free).

fields.name: target_molecule
fields.description: Typed projection of conditions: target molecule; 'n/a' where the concept does not apply.

resources.name: validation-targets
resources.title: Pre-registered validation targets (reproduction / consistency / independent tiers)

fields.name: target_id
fields.description: Unique target identifier, e.g. V_kouchen_base.

fields.name: observable
fields.description: The observable being checked.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Observed/target value.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of the observable.

fields.name: unc
fields.description: Reported uncertainty on the observed value.

fields.name: conditions
fields.description: Physical conditions of the observation.

fields.name: source_bibkey
fields.description: Key(s) resolvable in references.bib.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Exact locator inside the source.

fields.name: tolerance
fields.description: Pre-registered pass tolerance: [a,b] absolute interval, +-N% relative, or a qualitative pass rule (e.g. 'monotone trend', 'context-only') where the check is not numeric.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Class/tier and framing notes.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Prior parameter name.

fields.name: nominal
fields.description: Nominal (central) value.

fields.name: low
fields.description: Lower bound of the prior box.

fields.name: high
fields.description: Upper bound of the prior box.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit of the parameter.

fields.name: distribution
fields.description: Prior distribution shape (e.g. uniform).

fields.name: ledger_symbols
fields.description: Rate symbol(s) in rates.csv this prior maps to.

fields.name: rationale
fields.description: Why this prior/box was chosen.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Unique source identifier.

fields.name: citation
fields.description: Human-readable citation.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year.

fields.name: tier
fields.description: T1 design study / T2 demonstrated technology / T3 operating facility.

fields.name: basis_as_published
fields.description: The quantity as the source states it; a row the ledger derived instead says so verbatim ('DERIVED, not published as such').

fields.name: projectile_target
fields.description: Projectile and production target.

fields.name: capture_scheme
fields.description: Pion/muon capture scheme.

fields.name: recapture_credit_applied
fields.description: Whether a recapture/recovery credit was applied by the source.

fields.name: recapture_factor
fields.description: Recapture credit factor if the source quotes one; recorded even when recapture_credit_applied=false, so the credit is visible but not folded in.

fields.name: eta_acc_assumption
fields.description: Accelerator (electricity -> beam kinetic energy) efficiency assumed by the source, if stated. Dividing by it is a NUMERAIRE change, not a stage advance.

fields.name: eta_mu_assumption
fields.description: Fraction of PRODUCED mu- the source assumes reach the D-T vessel (capture+transport+moderate+stop collapsed into one factor). Recorded, never folded into the cost.

fields.name: eta_mu_evidence_status
fields.description: Provenance grade of eta_mu_assumption; 'author_declared_arbitrary' where the source itself calls the value arbitrary or unknown.

fields.name: value_as_published
fields.description: The published value in its own unit, or 'not published as such' where the row is a numeraire conversion derived here.

fields.name: unit_as_published
fields.description: Unit of value_as_published.

fields.name: normalized_GeV_per_mu
fields.description: Energy per muon in GeV at THAT ROW'S own (stage, numeraire) coordinate. NOT a single common basis: values are not commensurable across either axis.

fields.name: numeraire
fields.description: The units the energy is counted in: beam_kinetic | electrical_minimal | electrical_site. Wall-plug is a NUMERAIRE, not a stage, so it applies at any stage.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: How far along the muCF chain the cost is counted: produced | captured | transported | moderated | stopped_useful_in_dt, plus the off-chain sink stopped_other_target.

fields.name: evidence_status
fields.description: Provenance grade of this row's number: primary | primary_cited | derived_here | author_declared_arbitrary | assumption | absent. The last three are NOT sourced.

fields.name: useful_fraction_sourced
fields.description: At the terminal stage only: whether the source establishes that the stopped muons it counts are 'useful' in the cycle-closure sense.

fields.name: basis_class
fields.description: DEPRECATED alias of 'stage' (produced | collected | stopped_in_dt | stopped_other_target), kept for downstream compatibility and validated against it. A per-produced/collected figure is a LOWER BOUND on the per-stopped-in-D-T cost counted in that row's own numeraire, never across numeraires.

fields.name: charge_basis
fields.description: Charge counted: mu_minus | mixed (mu+ and mu- together, so the mu--only cost is higher by a factor this ledger does not source) | mu_plus_only (irrelevant to muCF).

fields.name: derivation
fields.description: Arithmetic taking the published value to the normalized basis.

fields.name: source_bibkey
fields.description: Key(s) resolvable in references.bib.

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Exact locator inside the source.

fields.name: needs_verification
fields.description: True if the exact digit/locator is not yet pinned.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Caveats and context.

resources.name: yamashita-kino-lambda-c-T
resources.title: Digitized normalized cycle rate lambda_c(T) from Yamashita-Kino 2022 Fig. 3a (c_t=0.5, EVM-SPM-FIF band centreline)

fields.name: T_K
fields.description: Temperature in kelvin (20-800 K grid).

fields.name: lambda_c_s^-1
fields.description: Normalized cycle rate lambda_c at c_t=0.5 (s^-1), pixel-traced band centreline.

fields.name: digitization_unc_rel
fields.description: Relative digitization uncertainty (pixel read + band-centre-vs-solid-line ambiguity).

fields.name: source_bibkey
fields.description: Key resolvable in references.bib (YamashitaKino2022).

fields.name: source_locator
fields.description: Exact figure/panel locator inside the source.
